profiles.E: C/ROM stack through flash callback entry, no pre-mask helper; not a universal feasible witness
profiles.U: maximum stack at a potentially unmasked instruction, no IRQ activation added
profiles.M: maximum stack inside known masked flash/allocator descendants; None means no masked descendant

enumeration_visitor: separate supplied unmasked/masked bounds V_U,V_M: U=max(676,216+V_U), M=216+V_M if visitor has a masked descendant; sole actual GC visitor has no filesystem reentry
array_frames: counted once by exact own frame, not per source loop/depth
